pairs.subject: tiling-texture-acceptance
pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/seam-check.ts:82 The wrap-around check reduces each axis to a mean absolute difference only, with no maximum, so a short hard break across the edge (a shifted feature) is averaged away over the whole edge and passes, which is the case the technique says must fail.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/seam-check.ts:82 One-pixel bands, per-axis scores, the worst edge named, and a non-throwing safe variant that returns null are all present; but only the mean is kept (no max), so 'mean clean, max high → fail' cannot happen.

src/lib/visual-gen/seam-check.ts:63 Any caller can pass its own cutoff per call, which the technique forbids. The 0.08 (~20/255) default is called 'conservative' but has no corpus, no catch/false-flag rates, no date and no provisional label.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/biome-textures.ts:26 Steps 1–2 are realized (closed Biome union, noun + condition words). Step 6 fails: the suffix is repeated in every entry. Step 7 fails: no class is recorded. The vocabulary is never composed into a live generation path.
